newsitem.title: UK: Energy group to buy Citizens Lehman Power. [CORRECTED 17:48 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Energy group to buy Citizens Lehman Power. [CORRECTED 17:48 GMT]

text.p: The Energy Group Plc said on Monday that it had signed an agreement to acquire full ownership of Citizens Lehman Power L.L.C, a U.S. based power marketer, for a consideration of a maximum $120 million (Corrects from $200 million).
Energy Group said it was making an initial payment of $20 million.
Citizens Lehman is currently owned by Lehman Brothers Holdings and Citizens Energy Corporation.
The company would be renamed as Citizens Power L.L.C. and would be a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Energy Group.
The company would focus on eletricity trading, risk management and electricity asset restructuring in the United States.
